releaseNotes: v1.1.1: Apple TVs are also found through their AirPlay announcement, so they still show up under Found on your network when the hub's Companion list misses them. No Done needed after updating.
author: jdthomas24
tags: Apple TV, TV, video, local control

apps.name: Apple TV Integration
apps.description: Finds Apple TVs on your network, pairs each with the PIN shown on the TV and creates one device per Apple TV.

drivers.name: Apple TV
drivers.description: One per Apple TV. On/off with live power state, playback controls, Siri Remote buttons, volume, app launching and now playing, over an encrypted local connection.
